company.name: Starsky Robotics
company.shortDescription: Starsky Robotics is an autonomous trucking company that aims to make roads safer while also providing employment for truck drivers.
company.description:
Trucking is the backbone of the American economy, moving 70% of all freight. Truck drivers risk their lives by spending months away from their families to keep the American economy moving.

They are working to make trucks autonomous on the highway and remotely controlled by drivers for the first and last mile. Their trucks will make roads safer while giving drivers meaningful work close to their homes and families.

productsAndServices.description: Starsky Robotics developed technology for autonomous trucks, focusing on making road transportation safer by automating the driving process.
productsAndServices.name: Autonomous Trucking Technology

productsAndServices.description: The company provided services for remote operation of trucks, allowing human operators to control vehicles from a distance, enhancing safety and efficiency.
productsAndServices.name: Remote Truck Operation
